description:
Configure inbox auto-reply (stored in ~/.aibtc/config.json). Call with no arguments to see the current settings. A systemPrompt (the agent's voice / personality / what it can help with) is required before auto-reply can be enabled. The model must be live on inference.aibtc.com; it is checked against the catalog when set. dailyCapSats caps sats spent on reply inference per UTC day, on top of the wallet-wide spending limit.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

dailyCapSats.description: Most sats spent on reply inference per UTC day. Default 1000.

enabled.description: Allow inbox_auto_reply to post replies. Dry runs work while disabled.

model.description: Inference marketplace model id (see GET https://inference.aibtc.com/v1/models). Default meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt for reply generation: who the agent is, its tone, what it offers, what it won't do.

name: inbox_auto_reply_configure
